basics.headline: Staff platform engineer · reliability and developer experience
basics.summary: Owns platform services end to end. Strong on incident leadership, API freezes under pressure, and stakeholder resets with evidence. Goes by Jordan. Prefers concrete examples over abstract claims.

items.title: Staff Software Engineer
bullets: Owned the checkout platform rewrite; cut p99 latency about 40ms after a fight with Product on scope.
Led Sev-1 cache stampede response as incident commander; shipped runbooks and paging changes after.
Froze a public API for one week after two Sev-1s despite PM pressure; error rate dropped about 12% over 30 days.
Reset Sales priority from a new widget to auth hardening using churn evidence in a leadership review.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Chose eventual consistency over strong reads to hit a Friday launch; owned the downside on stale dashboards.
Rotated leaked secrets from a public repo and added a pre-commit scanner the team still uses.
Mentored two engineers on on-call ownership and post-incident writeups.

items.name: popisnatch
items.summary: Internal developer tooling CLI that cut local env setup from hours to minutes.
bullets: Designed the plugin model and owned release quality gates.
Measured adoption across three product squads within one quarter.
